sanskrit: abhyarcyeti || kalpitaṃ viṣṭaraṃ abhyarcya pīṭha pūjāṃ
mūlahṛdayena vā tasyā yonyāṃ vinikṣipet || atha
kalpayet | evaṃ sarvatra draṣṭavyam || ābhyāṃ puruṣeśābhyāṃ
parito maṃgalaṃ aṣṭamaṃgalaṃ nyaset || maṃgalāni gaṇayati ||
madhu ca nyasediti yojyam || śarāvādiṣviti | bhāvaḥ | tadbahiḥ
rakṣārthaṃ kṣipet || śeṣaṃ sugamaṃ kṛtveti evaṃ
vinyasya kramāt pūraṇoktamantra kramāt snāpayediti saṃgrahaḥ ||
salilaiḥ snāpayediti pratyekaṃ parigharṣaṇaṃ yojyam || bhūyo
vyavahitenānvayaḥ || vastraṃ vāmena vai dadediti madhyaṃ vākyaṃ
maṇḍapaṃ nayet || dvāradeśe tu saṃprāpte rathādavatārya
paramātmani tat paramīkaraṇāya yojayitvā tatastatvāni saṃharet ||
śive saṃharediti yathānyāyaṃ padārthaḥ || evaṃ liṃgasthajīvaṃ
bījabhāvaṃ gatairīśānādi kāryāṇi kalpayet || evaṃ pañca
kramādviduḥ iti || nyasaprakāramāha - teneti tena uddhṛtena bījena
napuṃsakaśilā madhyaṃ yathā bhavati tathā vinyasedityarthaḥ ||
praṇayanakramamāha arghya hasta ityādi || dvābhyāṃ dvāreti
ityarthāt tasmai tebhyaśca śaktitato dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt ||
saṃśodhyā | samyagrahātirikta doṣaśamanena śodhyā || ta eva naḥ
ātmaśuddhiṃ ātmano jīvasya sūkṣmadehasya ca śuddhiṃ kuryāt ||
nimittā ityādi || śivāgame patanādyā bahavonimittā durnimittāni
dine dine acchidrā dhārā kartavyā || āpūryetyetadvivṛṇoti
pūrvaṃ nimittāranivṛtārcanaṃ devaṃ dhārānte || yāmona vihitaḥ
samanantaraṃ avagāhaṃ kuryāt || avagāhaṃ vivṛṇoti pātramityādi
aṣṭottaraśataṃ hunet || atha dūrvābhiḥ vaktra mantreṇa sahasraṃ
mantraliṃga viṣayaṃ śuddhyantaraṃ darśayati || liṃga iti liṃge
|| ārṣo ṅībbhāvaḥ tāḥ samidhaḥ ādyavidyayā aṣṭottaraśataṃ
darśayati bhinna iti || pūrṇe snapanāyādhivāsite kalaśe bhinne
ayutaṃ daśasahasraṃ homyam upasaṃharati || nigada vyākhyātametat
tatra nyastāni ratnāni svayameva vā dadyāt iti || atha
uktamanuṃ japan || pūraṇe dravyavinyāse mantraṃ pañcākṣaraṃ
